summary.text: Amy Warhurst is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 90, running against incumbent Republican Steve Huebert in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator, she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Amy Warhurst earned a high school diploma from Ell-Saline High School, a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 2010, a graduate degree from Fort Hays State University in 2018, and a graduate degree from the University of New England in 2024.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Warhurst said Kansas is where she was born and raised and where she educated her three children, and that she holds degrees in horticultural therapy, elementary education and special education as well as an EdD in education.
She wrote that she would work to reduce property taxes, promote education and oppose the construction of data centers, and named affordability and education among her three key campaign messages.
